_comment: Single source of truth for every converter under third_party/ossie/converters/. tests/test_ossie_spec_conformance.py::test_converter_directory_set_matches_manifest fails if upstream adds/removes/renames a converter directory that isn't reflected here - that's the trip wire for 'go port the new/changed converter' on a submodule bump. `status: ported` converters are vendored under src/lexis/_vendor/ossie_converters/ and checked byte-for-byte (modulo the documented `from ossie import` rewrite) against the submodule by the same test file. `status: todo` converters have no Lexis transpiler yet. `language: java` converters (polaris, salesforce) can't be vendored as Python source at all - the plan for those is a from-scratch Lexis-native reimplementation, not a port.
